settled_definitional_conclusions: The crossing time Phase 3 computes is the crossing of the line of scrimmage derived from yardline_side/number/play_direction at the tracked position: LOS formula, sign and onset handling are verified by the checks in los_validation.csv.

player_get_off is not that quantity: it behaves as the crossing of a plane displaced past the line, by an amount that is a DISTANCE (it scales as 1/speed), not a clock offset (no constant can fit it), and it is a plane (within-play slope of implied distance on depth is 1, not 0).
The displacement is per play, not per player: two rushers on the same snap agree about the plane to within a few tenths of a yard, while different plays differ by more.

denominators.gap_set: every rep in snaps.parquet with a tracked crossing and a label (this reproduces the 1,819 in the brief)
denominators.primary_only: the same restricted to in_primary_set (1,368 in the sample)
